label: lem:all_inner_visits_bound
title: Bound on all inner-loop visits
statement:
The total number of inner-loop visits is at most
    \[
        (\text{number of composites }\le n) + (n-1).
    \]
    In particular, it is at most $2n-2$.
proof: Add the bound from \ref{lem:successful_visits_bound} (at most $n-1$ successful visits) and from \ref{lem:extra_visit_bound} (at most $n-1$ extra visits).
